description: This Java class defines a custom Swing component 'RomTree' extending JTree, used for displaying and interacting with a tree structure of ROMs, categories, and related nodes in the RomRaider application. It includes event handling for mouse clicks and key bindings, and methods for managing selection and display of associated tables.

classes.name: RomTree
classes.description: A custom Swing JTree component for displaying ROM and category nodes with interaction handling.
